title: hedyosmos secundus
intro: Hedyosmos secundus, commonly known as Strychnine Tree, is a plant species that belongs to the Ebenaceae family. The plant is known for its toxic properties, particularly its seeds and leaves, which contain high concentrations of strychnine, a potent neurotoxin. However, the plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, such as fever, rheumatism, and skin diseases, due to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Hedyosmos secundus, including strychnine, alkaloids, and flavonoids, are believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties, although its use is highly cautioned and strictly regulated due to its toxicity.
